items.title: Chord Energy (CHRD) Executive Shannon Kinney Resigns
items.summary: Chord Energy (NasdaqGS:CHRD) announced the resignation of Executive Vice President, Chief Administrative Officer, General Counsel, and Corporate Secretary Shannon Kinney. Kinney is leaving Chord Energy to become General Counsel at ConocoPhillips. The move marks a significant change in Chord Energy's leadership and legal oversight structure.
